thread:
Maya: Heads-up — ran a quick grep against the runtime examples and found a handful of broken internal links and one missing code snippet.
Maya: sample hits: `/docs/runtime/guides/kv-cache#prefetch` -> 404, `/docs/runtime/examples/realtime.md` image link 403, and `examples/async_batch.py` reference in the guide pointing to a removed path.
Lucas: thanks for the scan. can you paste the grep you ran? i can triage the runtime ones.
Maya: sure — `rg \"(/docs/runtime/|examples/async_batch.py)\" -n docs/ runtime/ | sed -n '1,50p'` — found 5 unique broken refs across runtime guide and examples index.
Olga: docs-bot also flagged `runtime/guides/kv-cache` in last nightly run (see below). i can take the kv-cache anchor if it's a short patch.
docs-bot: nightly-link-scan: 5 findings in /docs/runtime — anchors missing, 1 image 403, 2 example path mismatches. https://internal-scans/reports/173800
Sam: @Olga +1 on kv-cache. i can grab the examples index and the image rehost.
Maya: awesome. small asks:
- add a tiny redirect for `examples/async_batch.py` -> `examples/async/async_batch.py` if the path moved, OR update the guide to point to the new path.
- rehost `images/runtime/realtime-diagram.png` to our CDN and swap the URL (403 currently).
- if anyone touches the kv-cache page, please check the heading IDs — the anchor `#prefetch` was removed when we refactored headings.
Lucas: for the redirect option, do we have a simple netlify/_redirects or nginx rule pattern to add? or prefer PR to change the doc?
Olga: i'd prefer PR change — safer. adding redirects is fine short-term but we should update references.
Olga: i'll open a small PR for the kv-cache heading and update the anchor to `#prefetching` with a 1-line note in the frontmatter to preserve SEO.
Sam: i'll handle the image: uploading to `s3://redwood-docs-assets/runtime/` then replace URL.
Maya: couple of conventions:
- tag PRs with `docs/quickfix` in the branch name
- include `Fixes: GH-<scan-id>` in the PR body so our triage tooling picks it up
- add yourself as frontmatter owner on any edited page you touch if no owner exists
Lucas: copying example patch i used earlier:
```
# replace broken example path
rg \"examples/async_batch.py\" -l docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -i \"s|examples/async_batch.py|examples/async/async_batch.py|g\" {}
```
Lucas: i'll run that on the examples index and open PR if it doesn't break the build.
Maya: @Lucas please also run `make docs-serve` locally and click through the runtime guide TOC — seen weird TOC collapse once when anchors changed.
Olga: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — updated kv-cache anchor, added frontmatter owner: `olga@redwood` and small note about prefetched keys.
Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — rehosted realtime-diagram.png, updated URL in runtime/examples/realtime.md :thumbsup:
Lucas: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — bulk replace for async_batch path, ran local linkcheck.
Maya: i'll queue a docs-ci run and do a quick visual pass after CI passes. tagging @Olga @Sam @Lucas for review — can we aim to merge by EOD PST?
Olga: ACK, i'll review and merge once CI green.
Sam: ack.
Lucas: will address any CI feedback fast.
Maya: thanks team. leaving this thread open for any follow-ups. if anything else pops in the scan i'll drop another note.
docs-bot: link-scan-post: follow-up scheduled — next full scan in 24h. If PRs merge, please comment `resolved-by-scan` on the report.
Maya: done — added `resolved-by-scan` to the report when PRs merge. :eyes:
Lucas: quick note — added `docs/quickfix/runtime-link-sweep` branch name to the three PRs.
Maya: great. closing the loop here once merges land. :shipit:
